description: This file defines a utility enum 'BonjourServiceResolverSupport' with static methods for starting DNS service resolution and normalizing hostnames in a Bonjour network service context.

classes.name: BonjourServiceResolverSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to manage Bonjour service resolution and hostname normalization.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules the given NetService on the main run loop and initiates resolution with a specified timeout.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Removes unnecessary whitespace and trailing periods from a hostname string.
